critical_code_review_comments: MessageBubble.jsx: unused import of ApprovalActionCard should have been caught by ESLint (`no-unused-vars`). The initial compile error also would have been caught by pre-commit lint. Consider enabling lint-on-save and adding CI lint gate.

dev_gates.py: `maybe_require_approval` reuses existing pending approvals when a member re-submits (line 163-167 — nice, avoids duplicate chat spam). But there's no rate limit for a member spamming publish (each will find and re-return the same pending approval — safe). Good design.

dev_gates.py `decide_action_approval`: when the approved action's inner call raises (e.g. _do_publish throws), status still flips to 'approved' with `error` set on the doc. Chat message correctly says '⚠️ Approved, but execution failed: ...'. Good.

PreviewCommentsPanel.jsx: `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load])` and `load` depends on `base` which depends on props — fine. But if projectId prop changes to a new project mid-drawer-open, the previously-loaded comments briefly linger before the fetch settles. Not user-visible in this flow but worth a `setComments([])` at the top of load().

dev_publish.py `_do_publish` auto-suffixes slug on collision with i in range(2,10) — capped at 9 tries. If ever a viral name hits that limit the publish fails with the generic slug error. Consider longer range or falling back to `-${uuid_short}`.

MessageBubble.jsx already grew to 620 lines — this file is a hot spot for regressions (this iteration's compile error was the second recent one). Consider splitting per-message-type render subtrees (call, build, approval, ai-question, ai-answer) into their own files.

rca of the issue.reproduction_1: Open ANY chat page → red 'Compiled with problems: SyntaxError: /app/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.jsx: Unexpected token (621:15)' overlay covers screen.
rca of the issue.root_cause_1: The main agent added a new render branch (the CallRecordCard / call_id block) but the previous version's closing JSX was not fully removed — 9 lines of dead JSX (`` / `)}` / `` / another `` / `` / `);` / `}`) remained AFTER the correct function-closing `}` at line 620. Babel-loader hit the stray `` at line 621 as top-level and threw. This kind of merge artifact is invisible to eyeball review but very obvious to any lint or `yarn build` step.
rca of the issue.mitigation_1: Removed lines 621-629 (verified end-of-file now cleanly closes with `}\n`). Frontend recompiles clean. Suggest enabling `yarn eslint --fix` on every commit, or a `yarn build` smoke check in CI.
